name: stance-retreat-heal
description: retreat when damaged, to a place of healing: four rangers with retreat at 70% are hurt to about 40%; they go to the barracks, are healed and go back. The heal building (AmericaBarracks) is an assumption: if the trace says "goes to the rally point", change the template. (Needs the commits with MSG_ASSIST_BASE_DEFEND / MSG_ASSIST_STANCE; until then "this build has no command".)
log: ^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ at \d+% goes to heal facility
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ goes back to
